messages:
anya: quick sync on post-launch email plan for Launchpad webinar attendees. thinking a 3-email micro-drip + weekly mini-digest for 3 weeks. :sparkles:

matt: yep. segment attendees: watched >=50% vs registered but no-show. watched -> tips + feedback invite. no-show -> recording + re-invite in 7d.

jess: subject variants: 'Highlights from Launchpad', 'Quick recap + recording', 'Top takeaways you can use today'  propose A/B test 24h vs 48h for the first nudge.

oliver: add a high-engagement bucket (asked q's / clicked resource). send advanced-use-cases + personalized CTA.

anya: proposed cadence: email0 immediate (thanks + recording), email1 48h (3 quick wins + CTA), email2 7d (case study + webinar follow-up). weekly mini-digest Fridays, 3 bullets max.

matt: inbound routing: tag leads 'webinar_watched_50plus' -> SDR queue. others -> nurture. Lead scoring: +5 for resource click, +10 for chat question.

jess: marketing ops: add UTMs and hidden form fields. i'll draft templates. matt, what fields do SDRs need on handoff?

matt: email, company, role, watch_percent, resources_clicked, chat_question_flag, utm_campaign. Also preferred contact window if provided.

campaign-bot: campaign 'launchpad_postlaunch_171452' scheduled. Sends: email0 -> 1714527056, email1 -> 1714699856, email2 -> 1715131856. :robot_face:

oliver: copy tweak: make email1 subject '3 quick wins from Launchpad'  more action-oriented. Also suggest single primary CTA for the experiment.

anya: good call. jess, can you drop templates + subject variants by EOD? also need a 5-question micro survey for email2, <30s to complete.

jess: yes. i'll put templates in #marketing-ops and upload to HubSpot campaign manager. sample scheduling curl for ops:

curl -X POST "https://api.hubspot.com/marketing/v3/campaigns" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {{TOKEN}}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"name":"Launchpad postlaunch","sendDate":"2024-04-01T15:00:00Z","utm":{"campaign":"launchpad_postlaunch"}}'

I'll include three subject variants and UTM parameters.

anya: rotation across cohorts to avoid deliverability fatigue. rotate 3 subject lines. send window 10am-2pm local. suppression: unsubscribes removed immediately.

matt: ops please create segment for 'clicked recording' for quicker SDR follow-up. also run soft 5% experiment on CTA density (single vs multi).

oliver: let's add measurement plan: open rate, CTR, recording plays, demo requests, lead-to-opportunity within 14 days. run significance at 90% for experiments.

jess: noted. i'll add tracking in the template and set up dashboards. also creating the short survey (5 qs) for email2: 1) what was most helpful? 2) what do you want next? 3) current blockers? 4) interest in trial? 5) consent to be contacted?

anya: great. owners: jess -> templates + hubspot config; matt -> SDR handoff fields + routing; oliver -> experiments + measurement; anya -> compile and publish runbook. i'll share runbook in the channel when ready.

matt: one more: ensure suppression on email0 for unsubscribes; throttle sends to avoid spikes.

jess: will set send throttling and suppression rules. uploading everything to Campaign Manager now.

anya: perfect. thanks team! i'll share the final runbook and timeline in #marketing and schedule a 15m follow-up if anything blocks.
